lines.en: Each contestant will throw two aeroplanes.
Oh! Oh, man, it slipped out of my hand.
What a whiff. How'd that happen? God!
Dwight told me about your situation.
And we have a winner. And it's Dwight. And it is everyone, because this is over.
Two grand, huh? I know a guy can turn that into $800. And it's me.
Well, I guess you needed the money more than me. Huh? Use it wisely.
I was disappointed in Dwight today. He showed a weakness that was unbecoming, even if he did do it for me.
I don't need pity. And I don't need charity. I have my dignity. And that's enough. And as long as I have that, I'll be okay.
